title: Streak / weekly summary email
description: Every Friday afternoon, email the teacher a summary: 'You taught 14 lessons with Adaptly this week. 92 pupils received differentiated work. 3 misconceptions re-taught.' Provides HOD/SENCO morale + the leverage to upsell to leadership.
rationale: User's improvement #12 (e). Without an end-of-week beat, daily use produces no felt return. The summary turns invisible labour into evidence the teacher can show their HOD / SENCO / line manager.
steps: Add server/jobs/weeklySummary.ts: cron `0 15 * * 5`. Aggregates the user's last-7-days activity (worksheets generated, pupils impacted from class-pack history, scan-and-mark batches, re-teaches if PB3 shipped).
Email body: stat cards + a streak badge (consecutive weeks with ≥ 3 lessons generated). Link to a /summary/:weekId page with full breakdown.
Build /summary/:weekId page that re-uses the same aggregator so a teacher can deep-link to past weeks.
do_not_touch: PD4 monday-morning email — separate template + cron
acceptance_criteria: A user with at least 1 lesson this week receives a Friday email at 15:00.
Streak badge increments correctly week over week.
Deep-link /summary/2026-W18 shows the same numbers as the email.
verification: Manual: trigger via admin route; click into deep-link page.
